symbols: n text bytes, m pattern bytes, r positions, c hash candidates, P aggregate pattern bytes, k pattern count, V trie nodes, z triples
scope: Code-path review plus one bounded repeated-byte Python observation per algorithm; C++ bounds use equivalent code paths and are tested separately.
alphabet: All 256 bytes; terminal symbol 256 for suffix tree. C++ map lookup is O(log sigma), sigma<=257.

naive-pattern-matching.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

knuth-morris-pratt.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

rabin-karp.mechanism: polynomial rolling update and exact candidate verification
rabin-karp.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

z-algorithm.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

boyer-moore.mechanism: bad-character and strong good-suffix; no Galil rule
boyer-moore.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

manacher.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

suffix-array.mechanism: rank-pair comparison sorting, doubling, Kasai LCP
suffix-array.time_bound: query O(m log n+r log r)
suffix-array.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

suffix-tree.mechanism: direct insertion with range-labelled edge splitting
suffix-tree.time_bound: contains O(m), find O(m+r log r) for fixed alphabet
suffix-tree.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof

aho-corasick.mechanism: dense transitions, BFS failure, uncopied output links
aho-corasick.timing_assertion: none; measured once, not an asymptotic proof
